{{Top|leg}}
The '''Code of the Claim''' was established by independent [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] to settle claim disputes on newly discovered [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] laws, the first scout to register the find claimed the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] prize. However, in cases of claim jumping, no payment was offered to the scout until an investigation was carried out. The Code of the Claim was concocted to resolve the situation; if multiple claims had been registered before the credits were paid out, the scout declared a [[Mutual Claim Registration]] and split the reward. The establishment of the Code of the Claim led to more claim jumping as many scouts felt they were entitled to jump a claim as they had either previously had to settle for an MCR, or knew that they would have to settle in the future.
